intro: Search before you register, so no patient ends up with two records.

search.title: Find a patient
search.label: Search patients
search.placeholder: Name, mobile, MRN, national ID or date of birth
search.hint: Type at least two characters: a name, part of a mobile number, an MRN, a national ID or a date of birth (yyyy-mm-dd).
search.registerHint: Check the spelling, or register them as a new patient.

register.title: Register a new patient
register.intro: Name, mobile, gender and date of birth are enough to start. The patient can link a portal account later.
register.fullNameHint: As on the ID, in Arabic or English.
register.nationalIdHint: Optional: the 14 digits on the ID card.
register.duplicateTitle_one: This may be a patient we already have
register.duplicateTitle_other: These may be patients we already have
register.duplicateBody: Same mobile number, or same name and date of birth. Use the existing record, or save anyway if it's someone else, such as a family member sharing a phone.
